Plan your live wedding music

  • Decide whether you want garage throughout the live sets or as a final-set highlight alongside R&B, pop and soul.
  • Share specific song requests and check which are in the live repertoire. An artist influence does not mean every song by that artist is available.
  • Confirm the singers, MC and instruments included in your chosen lineup, together with space, power and venue sound restrictions.
  • Plan first-dance music and music between sets. Gotta Be Garage lists DJ-style playlists and optional band-member DJing; confirm what your quote includes.

Your questions answered

Can we hire a live UK garage band for a wedding?

Yes. Gotta Be Garage is a live UK garage show with a six-piece core lineup, two female lead vocalists and an MC. Availability and the final package depend on your date, venue and chosen lineup.

Can the band mix garage with other music?

Gotta Be Garage combines UK garage with R&B, pop and soul. You can discuss garage throughout the evening or a garage-focused final set, using the band’s repertoire to agree the music you want.

Can the band learn our first dance?

Gotta Be Garage offers a special song request, including a first dance. Discuss your song and the required notice with the team so the arrangement can be confirmed before booking.

What do you need to quote for a UK garage wedding band?

Send your wedding date, venue, preferred lineup, live-set timings and any DJ or special-song requirements. The team can then check availability, travel and the package details for your event.
